display.name: Invoice check
display.description: Checks an invoice against your threshold, holds the large ones for someone to approve, and emails the outcome.

requiredConnections.purpose: Sends the outcome of each check from your own Gmail account.

setup.title: Hold above
setup.description: Invoices above this amount wait for someone to approve them. Editable anytime.

setup.title: Email the outcome to
setup.description: Where each decided invoice is reported. Left empty, no email is sent.

pipeline.title: Invoice received
pipeline.description: A run is started with the invoice to check.

pipeline.title: Check the amount
pipeline.description: Compares the invoice against your threshold and holds it if it is above.

pipeline.title: Record the invoice
pipeline.description: Records the invoice once it is within threshold or has been approved.

pipeline.title: Email the outcome
pipeline.description: Sends the decision from your connected Google account, when an address is set.
